h2b_narrowing_if_G5_fails: S-NI removed before implementation; H2B narrowed to evidenced-concern detection with evidence-verified precision; recorded in P1 binding record
h2a: not_confirmatory; optional estimation-only module S-H2A requires operator activation before implementation

primary_quality_metrics.Q: macro-F1 over retained dimensions of evidenced concern E; all assigned non-removed locked-main-test units; ERROR/WITHHELD/missing = non-E; a dimension with no gold-E pair in a computation is omitted for every arm
primary_quality_metrics.S: unweighted mean of per-class F1 over {E, CON, IND, NA}, pooled over (unit, d in D*) pairs; ERROR/WITHHELD/missing = NONE_OUTPUT; a class with no gold pair in a computation is omitted for every arm; confirmatory iff G5 passed

coverage_floor_metric: R = macro recall of evidenced concern; same dimension-omission rule as Q
primary_property_metric: EVCP = verified E-claims / E-claims; verified iff gold E AND >=1 valid cited support span AND token precision of cited-support union vs gold-support union >= 0.5 AND some single gold support span has >= 0.5 of its tokens cited; zero claims -> undefined (dispositions under bootstrap.full_sample_EVCP_dispositions)

decision_rule.method: intersection-union test; each component one-sided 0.025 via two-sided 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI; no multiplicity adjustment within H2B
decision_rule.comparators: K = every designated configuration of B0, C_A and C_B; G = those of C_A and C_B; where rule J designates a set, each member is a separate comparator facing every component; more comparators only make PASS harder
decision_rule.Q_NI: for each k in K: PASS iff lower CI(Q_T - Q_k) > -delta_Q; FAIL iff upper CI < -delta_Q
decision_rule.S_NI: for each k in K: PASS iff lower CI(S_T - S_k) > -delta_S; FAIL iff upper CI < -delta_S; removed if G5 failed
decision_rule.R_NI: for each k in K: PASS iff lower CI(R_T - R_k) > -delta_Q; FAIL iff upper CI < -delta_Q
decision_rule.P_SUP: for each g in G: PASS iff lower CI(EVCP_T - EVCP_g) > delta_P (superiority margin); FAIL iff upper CI < delta_P; full-sample undefined EVCP -> FAIL or UNDEFINED without bootstrap
decision_rule.inconclusive: no FAIL and >= 1 UNDECIDED or UNDEFINED

margins.delta_Q: clamp((1 - F1_h)/2, 0.02, 0.05); F1_h = annotator-pair macro-F1 on E over D*, computed on reliability set RS before any arm runs [BIND value]
margins.delta_S: clamp((1 - S_h)/2, 0.02, 0.05); S_h = annotator-pair S on RS [BIND value]
margins.selection_dependent_margins: none (v1.2 Delta-reduced margins removed in v1.3)

bootstrap.cluster_list: locked-main-test clusters with >= 1 scored unit, ascending byte-wise cluster ID
bootstrap.draw: i(b,j) = int(SHA-256('e001-boot-v1:20260918:' + str(b) + ':' + str(j))[0:16 hex], 16) mod n; replicate b = multiset of c_(i+1), j = 1..n; units pooled with multiplicity
bootstrap.interval: exact order statistics, no interpolation: m = floor(0.025 B); lower = (m+1)th smallest of v-; upper = (B-m)th smallest of v+ (B = 10000: 251st and 9750th)
bootstrap.arithmetic: exact rational for every metric, difference and margin comparison
bootstrap.undefined_replicate: difference undefined if either arm's metric is undefined (EVCP: zero claims by T, comparator or both); enters v- as -1 and v+ as +1; > m undefined -> UNDECIDED
bootstrap.absent_dimension_or_class: omitted for every arm (gold-based); metric undefined only if all absent

full_sample_EVCP_dispositions.comparator_zero_claims: P-SUP UNDEFINED (control defect; blocks supported), no bootstrap

multiplicity: single confirmatory hypothesis H2B; all other analyses descriptive with unadjusted 95% CIs
reliability_set_RS: double-annotated units of initially active main-pool clusters in dev + double-annotated 20% QC subset of train; no locked units; reserve-activated units never added

gates.G1_reliability: on RS: Krippendorff alpha (nominal, binary E) >= 0.667 per dimension to retain (defines D*); >2 dimensions failing -> halted
gates.G3_annotator_qc: known-answer accuracy >= 0.90 against the frozen qc-key (protocol section 7.7)
gates.G4_minimum_sample: custodian-only, locked main test: >= 500 units, >= 100 clusters, >= 60 gold-E per retained dimension, >= 5 retained dimensions, and if G5 passed >= 80 gold-CON and >= 80 gold-IND pairs pooled over D*; only remedy reserve activation; else halted
gates.G5_state_reliability: on RS: Krippendorff alpha (nominal, four-class state pooled over D*) >= 0.667 keeps S-NI; failure narrows H2B (not a halt)
gates.locked_pool_agreement: computed after adjudication, sealed, released at U2 as descriptive only; never selects D*, margins, gates or design

sets.known_answer: >= 80 and no annotator sees an item twice

qc_pool.authors: QC team (>= 3), human-authored from QC-only briefs; no model output; no explicit self-harm; never written from experimental cards or units
qc_pool.key_labeling: two independent non-author QC-team labelers, blind; qualification/known-answer items admitted only if both agree on all seven statuses; adjudicator may drop (rubric-cited reason) but never re-key; practice items may be adjudicated
qc_pool.exclusions: QC team excludes T designers, implementers, the protocol author, experimental annotators, the adjudicator, the custodian and SHF writers; ADCP leakage rules apply
qc_pool.overlap_check: after M0: exact duplicates and char-5-gram Jaccard >= 0.6 against every M0 unit (all pools, active and reserve); hit -> QC unit dropped
qc_pool.freeze: qc-key v1.0 (set, QC unit ID, text SHA-256, key statuses) frozen after the overlap check and before any annotator sees any unit; SHA-256 posted on Issue #3
qc_pool.correction: no edits after commitment; defective items retired by the adjudicator with a rubric-cited reason; G3/qualification recomputed and both results logged; new items only via a new committed key version
qc_pool.raw_disagreement: all raw key labels retained immutable, including dropped items; admission rate and key-labeler agreement reported
qc_pool.use: qualification and G3 only; never gold, RS, metrics, development material or any arm input; released to the auditor at P3
qc_pool.owner: operator under B2; custodian runs the overlap check, holds and commits the key

split_method.unit_of_assignment: cluster (scenario card + variants; near-duplicates merged at char-5-gram Jaccard >= 0.6, active and reserve together)
split_method.cluster_manifest_M0: UTF-8 lines 'cluster_id<TAB>pool<TAB>active|reserve:<rank><TAB>unit_id:sha256(canonical_text),...'; commits cluster IDs, unit IDs and canonical-text hashes; SHA-256(M0) posted as a comment on Issue #3 before any salt exists; first comment binding (except the single pre-salt restart); post-M0 additions only via reserve activation; append-only custodian log
split_method.post_M0_immutability: canonical text immutable after M0; byte-exact hash verification at data freeze, P3, U1 and U2 and of every record's input_sha256; any post-M0 text-hash mismatch = S13

post_M0_removal_triggers.X4: missed label leak on a non-register unit
post_M0_removal_triggers.rules: prediction-blind; never from adjudicated locked gold; M0 line unchanged; before data freeze, except X3 which applies identically to all arms

split_method.restart: only way to use different canonical text: at most one; the irrevocable notice (reason, affected unit IDs, superseded M0 hash, operator authorization) must be posted on Issue #3 strictly before the original R* release; restart M0 differs only in listed units (new unit IDs for replacements); new salt from a new R* >= restart M0 commitment + 24 h; QC overlap rerun; superseded M0 preserved and disclosed
split_method.after_salt_round: no in-protocol re-randomization: a defect means removal (X1-X5) or halt (S13); new canonical text requires a new protocol version with a new locked test set from clusters not in this M0
split_method.salt: SHA-256('e001-salt-v1:' + M0_hash_hex + ':' + randomness_hex(R*)); R* = first round of drand default chain 8990e7a9aaed2ffed73dbd7092123d6f289930540d7651336225dc172e51b2ce (genesis 1595431050, period 30 s) released >= M0-commitment timestamp + 24 h; no re-salting
split_method.reserve_activation: >= 20% of active main clusters prepared before M0 with fixed ranks; activated only for G4, in ascending rank, complete batches of 10, each into its own hashed bucket; before data freeze; excluded from RS

quarantine_rules.integrity_register: A13 units and custodian-registered ADV units requiring label/status tokens: exempt from label-leak rewrite; ADV pool only; dev-visible ones usable only for capped evaluation and inspection; never training data, few-shot examples or cue/rule/prompt sources; 8-token artifact scan at P3 and U1; hit -> invalidated
quarantine_rules.explicit_self_harm_pool_defect: generated-unit review rejects explicit self-harm; custodian screens non-SR units before M0; any non-SR unit either annotator marks EXPLICIT_SELF_HARM is quarantined from all pools and metrics before data freeze, symmetrically across splits, from raw annotation only

B0.selection: rule J with dev Q as criterion (joint Q/S/R envelope; both candidates designated if the envelope is empty)

C_A.decoding: greedy, single pass, reasoning modes off, no retries
C_A.few_shot_source: main-pool train only, excluding quarantine-register units
C_A.selection: rule J over all full-dev-evaluated model x prompt configurations (single designation, or a designated set if the joint envelope is empty)

C_B.selection: rule J over all full-dev-evaluated (hyperparameters, seed) configurations; seeds 2-3 trained at the leading (primary) hyperparameters; median-dev-Q seed rule removed

T.escalation: dev only, after B0/C_A/C_B frozen: (a) some checked metric M (Q; S if G5 passed) is short: rung-best M < tau_M = max over designated control configurations (K) of M_dev - delta_M; AND (b) for every short M, closure (M with only NO_CANDIDATE_MENTION errors corrected >= tau_M) and dominance (that gain >= gain from correcting all NO_OUTPUT, NO_GOLD_SPAN and MENTION_PRESENT errors)
T.configuration_selection: rule J within the designated rung

optional_arms.F1: descriptive only; operator activation; written provider-terms check permits publication; not generator family; <= USD 150
optional_arms.S_H2A: estimation only; LoRA of the base model of C_A's primary designation on main-pool train; operator activation before implementation

selection_rule_J.anchors: independent per-metric maxima Q^max, R^max and, if G5 passed, S^max over the arm's configurations
selection_rule_J.joint_envelope: Q >= Q^max - delta_Q; R >= R^max - delta_Q; S >= S^max - delta_S if G5 passed
selection_rule_J.designation_nonempty: highest criterion in the joint envelope (EVCP for C_A, C_B, T, S-H2A; dev Q for B0); tie: Q, S, R, earliest ledger; undefined EVCP ranks last
selection_rule_J.designation_empty: controls: designated set {best criterion within each single-metric envelope M >= M^max - delta_M}, duplicates merged, each a comparator facing every component; T and S-H2A: single designation phi*_Q
selection_rule_J.primary: single designation or phi*_Q of a set; runs all locked pools; C_A primary supplies S-H2A base and F1 prompt; other set members run the locked main test only; all within the arm's locked-inference cap, else S7
selection_rule_J.failure: designated configuration fails gate (e) -> removed, J re-applied; empty -> fallback model or halt
selection_rule_J.margins: no selection-dependent margins; NI margins are delta_Q / delta_S for every comparator

all_arms: reproducible dev-mini predictions (deterministic arms identical; MPS-trained heads >= 99% identical statuses)
learned_arms_and_rungs: no NaN/Inf in any loss, gradient or parameter (numerical divergence)
convex solvers converge within declared iteration limit; gradient training completes its declared schedule or stops by the inner-validation rule
inner-validation-fold Q >= R0 Q on the same fold
competence_sanity_gates.diagnostic_only: per-epoch training and inner-validation loss curves reported; no loss-based pass/fail, halt or fallback
competence_sanity_gates.removed_from_v1_0: train-fold F1 >= dev F1 (not a valid competence invariant)
competence_sanity_gates.removed_from_v1_1: final-epoch loss <= 0.5 x first-epoch loss (not a valid competence invariant)

deterministic_subsets.dev_mini: dev clusters in ascending SHA-256('devmini:'+cluster_id) until >= 100 units
deterministic_subsets.inner_validation_fold: train clusters in ascending SHA-256('innerval:'+cluster_id) until >= 10% of train units

allowed_development_data: development material: train + dev + dev-visible portions of BND/ADV/SR (texts, gold, spans); never the QC pool or its key; fitting of learned parameters: main-pool train only; per arm <=60 dev-mini and <=12 full-dev evaluations; unlimited CV and inner-fold use inside train
unlock_sequence: U1 locked inputs only after artifact hashes committed
U2 gold, locked agreement and locked M0 mapping only after raw predictions committed

resource_ceilings.hardware: Mac mini M4, 16 GB unified memory, local (except optional F1)
resource_ceilings.energy: not measured; no energy claims permitted

adversarial_integrity_cases: included: 14 families A1-A14, >=15 units each; A13 on the integrity quarantine register
